caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a decorative rug or tapestry, featuring an ornate central oval medallion filled with an arrangement of flowers and leaves. The central oval background is light beige, bordered by scalloped edges in red and blue, with the floral cluster in the middle showcasing red, pink, blue, purple, and brown flowers, accompanied by green and olive leaves. Surrounding the central oval is a wider dark brown and green section, densely decorated with flowers and foliage predominantly in shades of red, blue, pink, and green, creating a wreath-like effect. The outer edge of the rectangle has a border pattern with alternating red diamond shapes and smaller blue and black details. The overall color palette is earthy, with dominant hues of green, brown, red, blue, and beige. Handwritten text appears below the drawing, reading "A 2114 - A" on the left and "Ruth M. Barnes" on the right.
title: Hooked Rug
